review.batchSummary:
Part 1/5: Reviewed 2 items (and their two context-only variants each) for S1 Chinese reading. Both items measure basic vocabulary knowledge/usage and their metadata accurately reflect that skill. Recommend PASS for both.

Part 2/5: Reviewed 2 items (grade S1, Chinese reading track). Both items measure basic modern-text reading comprehension skills and their supplied metadata are appropriate. Verdict: 2 PASS.

Part 3/5: Reviewed 2 items (each has two context-only variants). Both items PASS: metadata (label, topic, module) accurately describe the skill each question measures.

Part 4/5: Reviewed 2 items (each has two context-only variants). Both items' metadata appropriately describe the skill being assessed; no substantive revisions needed.

Part 5/5: Reviewed 2 items from chinese-reading S1. Both items measure paragraph/organisation and evidence-linked response skills appropriate for the supplied metadata. No substantive mismatches found; recommend PASS for both.

reviews.reason: The item asks for the closest meaning of the word 「妥當」, which assesses vocabulary knowledge/word meaning. The topic '語基與詞語', label '語基與詞語' and module '基礎掌握' accurately describe this basic vocabulary recognition task.

The item requires selecting the sentence in which 『妥當』 is most appropriately used, assessing vocabulary usage in context. The topic '語基與詞語', label '詞語運用', and module '基礎掌握' correctly reflect this skill.

The question asks students to infer a character's working style from a short description of actions (從人物行動歸納態度). This is a basic reading-comprehension inference skill about character/attitude in a modern text. The supplied topic ('現代文閱讀'), label ('現代文理解') and module ('理解與應用') accurately describe this skill at an appropriate level of specificity.

The item asks which practice best supports the judgement that '作者重視資料' — i.e., identifying textual evidence/authorial method in an expository text. This tests the ability to locate and use evidence in a text (主旨與證據), so the topic ('現代文閱讀'), label ('主旨與證據') and module ('理解與應用') are appropriate and not misleading.
The item tests the lexical meaning of a classical-Chinese word in context (文言實詞). The supplied label '文言實詞', topic '文言基礎' and module '理解與應用' correctly characterize this skill.
The item assesses sentence-level comprehension of a classical-Chinese sentence (文言句意). The label '文言句意', topic '文言基礎' and module '理解與應用' accurately reflect the skill measured.
題幹要求學生辨認句子所用的修辭手法（把城市擬人化），屬於辨識修辭/修辭與表達的基本能力。現有的 topic/label (“修辭與表達”) 與模組 (“理解與應用”) 均準確且教育上恰當。
題目測量學生理解使用具體例子支持觀點的表達效果（使觀點更具體且可信）。現有的 topic (“修辭與表達”)、label (“表達效果”) 及模組 (“理解與應用”) 能準確描述此技能，無需修改。

The question asks students to choose the most logical paragraph arrangement for a recount of a group collaboration, focusing on the relationship among viewpoint, examples and reflection. This directly assesses paragraph/paragraph-organization skills as labelled.

The item evaluates the ability to support an opinion with textual evidence (propose a view then cite/explain text), which matches the given label and topic about linking viewpoints to textual evidence.
